output_list.criticism: The transfer function does not check if the sender has enough balance to transfer the specified amount. This could lead to a reverted transaction if the sender does not have enough balance.

The transferFrom function does not check if the sender has enough balance to transfer the specified amount from the specified address. This could lead to a reverted transaction if the sender does not have enough balance.

The approve function does not check if the spender has enough allowance to spend the specified amount from the specified address. This could lead to a reverted transaction if the spender does not have enough allowance.

The transferFrom function does not check if the spender has enough allowance to spend the specified amount from the specified address. This could lead to a reverted transaction if the spender does not have enough allowance.

The approveAndCall function does not check if the spender has enough allowance to spend the specified amount from the specified address. This could lead to a reverted transaction if the spender does not have enough allowance.
